policy.unknowns: Every record lists what it does not know in unknowns[]. Missing is not the same as 'does not exist'.
policy.research_status: researched = our hand-researched dossier; not_researched = listed on our marketplace by the vendor, nothing verified beyond name, category and website.
policy.vendor_text: Records contain our research only, never vendor-submitted text or instructions.
